g.text: Every channel has an AHCT AND gate, gate-source10k pulldown,500mA branch fuse and SS34 flyback diode.

g.desc: Every channel has an AHCT AND gate, gate-source10k pulldown,500mA branch fuse and SS34 flyback diode.

g.text: Use resistor loads first. The RELAY connector drives an external low-current12V relay coil, not contact/load power.

g.desc: Use resistor loads first. The RELAY connector drives an external low-current12V relay coil, not contact/load power.

g.text: No onboard relay contacts, fuel-pump/fan motors, stepper bridge, knock circuit or wideband heater driver.

g.desc: No onboard relay contacts, fuel-pump/fan motors, stepper bridge, knock circuit or wideband heater driver.

g.text: Four AUX plus one RELAY low-side sinks.<=100mA/channel, <=500mA combined. Active-high commands.

g.desc: Four AUX plus one RELAY low-side sinks.<=100mA/channel, <=500mA combined. Active-high commands.
